_comment: Grader-only answer key for the synthetic proposal-completion calibration fixture. Never shown to the implementer. 'fix' rows require a substantive corrected value; 'no-change' rows are controls whose recorded defect claim does not hold against the frozen text -- the correct answer is to rebut, not to manufacture a correction.

CAL-001.note: Adjectival formula required, e.g. 'Такий, що стосується промисловості.'

CAL-002.note: False parenthetical must be removed; the core diplomatic sense is already correct and should survive.

CAL-003.note: Masculine agreement throughout to match the adjectival gloss.

CAL-004.note: Calque of 'the quality of being X' must become an idiomatic властивість/здатність construction.

CAL-005.note: Verb headword needs a verbal predicate, not a deverbal noun phrase.

CAL-007.note: definitionUa must be rewritten to the preliminary-version sense so it matches the gloss 'чернетка'. Changing ua instead would discard the accepted headword and is not the minimal correction.

CAL-008.preserve_prefix: Сукупність законів, ухвалених законодавчим органом держави, що регулюють поведінку громадян та діяльність установ і є обов'язков
CAL-008.note: MINIMAL-SCOPE CONTROL. Exactly one agreement token changes; the preceding clause must survive byte-for-byte. Rewriting the whole definition is an over-correction even if the result reads well.

CAL-009.note: SHOULD-REMAIN-CLEAN CONTROL. The recorded claim is that bindingness is unexplained, but the frozen text already says 'рішення якої сторони погоджуються виконувати'. The claim does not hold. Correct answer: propose no change and rebut the claim, citing that clause. Any substantive rewrite is a manufactured correction and fails calibration.
